Full layout width and encoding of logical and physical nested controls beyond the field groups observed.
Synchronization for nested descriptor and virtual APIC mappings and for preemption timer state outside the CPU pin window.
Timer callback behavior, deadline programming, and migration transfer format for cached nested state.

findings.text: Public helper decodes a VMX memory operand from exit qualification plus instruction information into a guest virtual address. It rejects register operands with undefined opcode fault, combines displacement with optional base and scaled index, applies address size truncation, adds segment base, then validates. Long mode uses untagging and canonical form check while legacy mode truncates to thirty two bits and enforces type writability, usability and limit with an exemption for flat segments. Failures queue general protection or stack faults and report handled status.

Public address normalizer removes linear address masking tags for data accesses. Fetch implicit and invalidate page accesses bypass unchanged, as do accesses outside sixty four bit mode. Bit sixty three selects user versus supervisor tagging policy. User policy consults active CR3 masking enablement with fifty seven bit mode taking precedence, supervisor policy consults CR4 enablement and five level paging selection. Untagging sign extends from the selected bit while preserving the original high bit so privilege class never changes.

Central nested event pump decides whether L1 observes a nested exit or execution continues toward L2. It evaluates initialization and startup signals, high priority faults, monitor trap, low priority debug traps, preemption timer, management interrupt, non maskable interrupt and external interrupts in priority order, honoring blocking by pending nested entry and by reinjection state. External interrupt handling distinguishes direct exit, acknowledge on exit, posted interrupt notification vector morphing, and local APIC sourcing. The fall through path completes posted interrupt processing.

Nested entry tail marks a nested run as pending, clears any preemption deadline flag, attempts transition to non root mode, requests L1 data cache flush, then caches shadow control state without rereading guest memory for migration safety. Halted guests stay halted unless wakeable by injected event or by enabled window exits with interrupts enabled. Wait for startup guests clear pending state and move to init received state. Failure paths clear pending state and map internal error to user exit, already synthesized exit to resume, otherwise to entry failure.

Exception to L1 is synthesized with exit qualification chosen by payload presence, page fault address, debug status with single step and polarity adjustment, else zero. Error code is attached only in protected mode and truncated to sixteen bits to avoid inducing nested entry failure when L1 reinjects. Soft versus hard exception type is recorded, non maskable unblock is set when no vectoring is in progress and non maskables are masked, then an exception style nested exit is delivered.

Posted interrupt completion is a no op unless a nested posted interrupt is pending. It requires a mapped descriptor, atomically tests and clears its outstanding notification marker, and if no vector remains it finishes. Otherwise it folds descriptor pending bits into the mapped virtual APIC page, raises the guest interrupt status low byte only when the new highest vector exceeds it, marks both mappings dirty, and succeeds. Missing descriptor or missing APIC mapping diverts to memory failure handling for input output emulation with a negative device error.
Highest posted vector is defined as the index of the topmost set bit across the two hundred fifty six bit pending bitmap, or negative one when the bitmap is empty.

Pending debug trap state exists only when an exception is pending for the debug vector. General detect contribution is treated as fault like by masking its indicator. Low priority status is determined by remaining debug status after excluding single step contribution.

Pending debug status from the current exception is propagated to guest pending debug state only when nonzero. Preemption timer need for L1 is true only when the L1 control enables the timer and the expired flag for nested state is set.

Fast poll reports pending nested activity without forcing an exit. Expired preemption timer or pending monitor trap immediately report true. For injection checks virtual delivery needs no manual work and reports false. Otherwise virtual delivery must be enabled, interrupts must be unblocked, and a virtual APIC page must be mapped. Pending is then decided by comparing received versus priority high nibbles, including a second check that folds in a pending posted descriptor whose notification marker is set.

Nested event blocking uses three related conditions. Pending nested entry blocks pending exceptions. Need for reinjection blocks events that hardware virtualizes. Either condition blocks events that require injection because priority management must wait until entry completes. Initialization startup monitor trap timer management non maskable and external events all return busy when their respective block applies.

Initialization signal clears its pending marker, propagates debug state, exits to L1 unless already in init received state, discards pending monitor trap and finishes. Startup signal clears its marker and exits only from init received state, otherwise it is ignored. Non maskable handling requires unblocked state and L1 exit interest, then exits, clears pending state and masks further non maskables. External interrupt handling respects L1 exit and acknowledge settings, consumes external then APIC sources, morphs the posted notification vector into pending posted state with IRR clearing, otherwise exits and acknowledges after exit so in service tracking is correct.

Extended control field class covers guest segment selector limit access rights and base for general segments plus local and task registers, descriptor table limit and base, pending debug exceptions, and bound configuration. All other field identifiers are not extended.

Rare state synchronization from physical to logical nested control is skipped unless a dedicated need sync flag is set. When active the caller asserts the loaded control is the primary one, pins execution, loads the secondary control, performs the rare synchronization, then restores the primary control and unpins.
Nested triple fault clears its pending request and is always converted into a triple fault style nested exit to L1 rather than being handled locally.

VM pointer fetch decodes the faulting guest address as a read of pointer width using exit qualification and instruction information, then reads that guest virtual address. Address decode failure reports handled status to the caller. Guest read failure is translated through memory failure handling and likewise reports handled status. Success returns zero with the pointer filled.

Shadow control allocation is permitted only when the loaded control is the primary one and no shadow already exists; violation is warned. On success a shadow region is allocated and cleared before return, otherwise the existing value is returned.

Entering VMX operation allocates secondary control, cached nested control, and cached shadow control with invalid guest address marker, optionally allocates shadow control when that feature is enabled, arms a pinned absolute monotonic preemption timer, allocates a fresh virtual processor identifier while clearing the last used value to force flush, marks secondary state uninitialized and operation active, and clears guest tracing control with intercept update when host guest tracing mode applies. Any allocation failure unwinds prior allocations and reports out of memory.

Rare synchronization holds a CPU pin across the window where the loaded control pointer is switched away from primary to secondary and back, preventing migration or preemption from changing the loaded control affinity mid sequence.

Logical nested control carries guest activity state, flags, entry interrupt information, exit interrupt information including error code and vectoring, exit qualification style fields, interrupt window and non maskable window controls, preemption timer and virtual delivery controls, and debug exception state. Fragments read activity and interrupt fields for entry decisions and write exit reason style fields when synthesizing exits.

Per virtual CPU nested state includes pending run flag, posted interrupt pending flag descriptor pointer and mappings for descriptor and virtual APIC, monitor trap pending flag, preemption timer expired flag deadline presence and timer object, secondary control object and initialization flag, operation active flag, virtual processor identifiers for current and last use, cached controls and shadow cache address, and posted notification vector. Fragments manipulate pending flags maps timers and caches without showing full type definition.

Nested entry must request L1 data cache flush to hide host contents from L2. Shadow caching after entry must not reread guest memory because destination memory may be absent during migration restore. Missing posted descriptor or virtual APIC mapping must take an input output emulation path rather than dereference null. Fresh virtual processor identifiers must flush stale translations from prior lives. Lost APIC interrupt sources must warn rather than silently drop.

Memory operand decoding must reject register forms, enforce canonical form in long mode, enforce segment type usability and limit in legacy mode with stack versus general fault selection by segment, and preserve privilege class during untagging. Error code truncation prevents accidental nested entry failure on reinjection.

Nested control ABI uses distinct failure codes for invalid host state versus invalid control field, distinct entry outcomes for success internal error synthesized exit and failure, distinct run pending marker, distinct halted and wait for startup activity states, and distinct init received multiprocessor state.

Nested exit ABI distinguishes initialization startup monitor trap preemption timer triple fault external interrupt and exception style reasons, with interrupt information encoding validity delivery of error code soft versus hard exception non maskable and external types plus unblock indication, and exit qualification carrying fault address or debug status.

Interrupt and debug ABI uses two hundred fifty six posted vectors with negative one meaning none, high nibble priority comparison between received and processor priority, debug vector with general detect single step and polarity bits, page fault debug undefined general stack non maskable and external vectors, and internal error exit with emulation suberror.

Address ABI encodes scale address size register indicator segment index and base selectors with validity bits in instruction information, sixteen thirty two and sixty four bit truncation rules, segment type writability and executability bits, flat segment exemption defined by zero base maximum limit and expand up code or data shape, and masking control bits for user fifty seven and forty eight plus supervisor enable and five level paging selection.
